body: The 13th at El Camaleón is the par five everyone circles: 532 yards, reachable with a good drive, water left of the green. {p0} found the fairway, then hit a 5-wood that never left the flag and stopped six feet past.

The putt went in dead centre and the team line for {c0} dropped two shots in one hole. It was the first eagle by a captain this season and, by the captain's own count, the first since the Del Mar exhibition.
